items.title: Dolly Douroux Adams Interview, 1962-04-18
items.q: Everyone knows Professor Minette, of course, is a great pianist.

ctx.x: It could be somewhere around there. I just remember some third black. I think it was destroyed.

Must have been torn down. Pelican was in there, too, and the restaurant, the famous restaurant. They had music there, too. Yeah. For a long time. But that whole part of town is going now since they had the new... It is, it is, yeah. The Civic Center and all the city hall and everything along in there. Is there anything else about your life that, uh, music and the musicians that you heard and played with that you could add? For instance, were there any other outstanding pianists? Everyone knows Professor Minette,…
Well, they didn't have very many piano plays at that time. I do remember Walter Deku.
